(1) defects are everywhere, (2) defects are not distributed randomly, (3) the number of defects in the code is a good predictor of the number of defects that will be detected during testing, (4) defects can be detected with high accuracy using a variety of methods, and (5) the accuracy of defect detection is not correlated to the size of the software system.
